cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(soldat_third_party_dependencies)
include(ExternalProject)

set(tools_path "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/../tools")
include(${tools_path}/install/tools.cmake)

function(create_import_cmake_file)
  # Parse the arguments
  set(options "")
  set(oneValueArgs "")
  set(multiValueArgs PROJECTS)
  cmake_parse_arguments(ARG "${options}" "${oneValueArgs}" "${multiValueArgs}" ${ARGN})

  # Validate input
  if(NOT ARG_PROJECTS)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "PROJECTS parameter is required")
  endif()

  set(THIRD_PARTY_CMAKE ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/install/third_party.cmake)
  file(MAKE_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/install)
  file(WRITE ${THIRD_PARTY_CMAKE} "# Autogenerated file, do not edit\n")

  # Process each project in the list
  foreach(proj ${ARG_PROJECTS})
    ExternalProject_Get_Property(${proj} INSTALL_DIR)
    file(APPEND ${THIRD_PARTY_CMAKE}
      "list(APPEND CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH ${INSTALL_DIR})\n"
    )
  endforeach()
endfunction()

find_program(CCACHE_FOUND ccache)
if(CCACHE_FOUND)
   set_property(GLOBAL PROPERTY CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER ccache)
   set_property(GLOBAL PROPERTY C_COMPILER_LAUNCHER ccache)
endif()

if (CCACHE_FOUND)
  set(COMPILER_LAUNCHER "-DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=ccache;-DCMAKE_C_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=ccache")
else()
  set(COMPILER_LAUNCHER "")
endif()

set(COMMON_FLAGS
  ${COMPILER_LAUNCHER}
  -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=<INSTALL_DIR>
  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE}
  -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=${CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS}
  -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=${CMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE}
)

set(THIRD_PARTY_SRC_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../third_party/src")
set(BUILD_ALWAYS_TOOLS ON)

### Tools

ExternalProject_Add(
  SDL3
  SOURCE_DIR "${THIRD_PARTY_SRC_DIR}/SDL"
  CMAKE_ARGS
    -DSDL_LIBURING=OFF
    -DSDL_INSTALL=ON
    -DSDL_UNINSTALL=OFF
    -DSDL_CCACHE=ON
    -DSDL_TEST_LIBRARY=OFF
    ${COMMON_FLAGS}
  UPDATE_COMMAND ""   # Not doing updates
  PATCH_COMMAND ""    # No patches
  USES_TERMINAL_CONFIGURE ON
  USES_TERMINAL_BUILD ON
  USES_TERMINAL_INSTALL ON
  BUILD_ALWAYS ${BUILD_ALWAYS_TOOLS}
)

ExternalProject_Get_Property(SDL3 INSTALL_DIR)
set(sdl3_install_dir ${INSTALL_DIR})

ExternalProject_Add(
  protobuf
  SOURCE_DIR "${THIRD_PARTY_SRC_DIR}/protobuf-3.19.1"
  CMAKE_ARGS
    -Dprotobuf_BUILD_TESTS:BOOL=OFF
    -Dprotobuf_BUILD_EXAMPLES:BOOL=OFF
    -Dprotobuf_BUILD_PROTOC_BINARIES:BOOL=OFF
    -Dprotobuf_MSVC_STATIC_RUNTIME:BOOL=OFF
    -Dprotobuf_MSVC_RUNTIME:STRING=$<IF:$<CONFIG:Debug>,MultiThreadedDebugDLL,MultiThreadedDLL>
    #-Dprotobuf_BUILD_SHARED_LIBS:BOOL=$<IF:$<PLATFORM_ID:Windows>,ON,OFF>
    -Dprotobuf_BUILD_SHARED_LIBS:BOOL=OFF
    ${COMMON_FLAGS}
    # other project specific parameters
  SOURCE_SUBDIR cmake
  USES_TERMINAL_CONFIGURE ON
  USES_TERMINAL_BUILD ON
  USES_TERMINAL_INSTALL ON
  BUILD_ALWAYS ${BUILD_ALWAYS_TOOLS}
)

ExternalProject_Add(
  libressl
  SOURCE_DIR "${THIRD_PARTY_SRC_DIR}/libressl-3.4.3"
  CMAKE_ARGS
      -DLIBRESSL_APPS=OFF
      -DLIBRESSL_TESTS=OFF
      -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF
      ${COMMON_FLAGS}
  USES_TERMINAL_CONFIGURE ON
  USES_TERMINAL_BUILD ON
  USES_TERMINAL_INSTALL ON
  BUILD_ALWAYS ${BUILD_ALWAYS_TOOLS}
)

find_package(Protobuf REQUIRED)
message(STATUS "Using protoc ${Protobuf_PROTOC_EXECUTABLE}")

ExternalProject_Get_Property(libressl INSTALL_DIR)
set(libressl_install_dir ${INSTALL_DIR})
ExternalProject_Get_Property(protobuf INSTALL_DIR)
set(protobuf_install_dir ${INSTALL_DIR})

ExternalProject_Add(
  GameNetworkingSockets DEPENDS libressl protobuf
  SOURCE_DIR "${THIRD_PARTY_SRC_DIR}/GameNetworkingSockets-1.3.0"
  LIST_SEPARATOR |
  CMAKE_ARGS
    -DUSE_CRYPTO=LibreSSL
    -DUSE_CRYPTO25519=Reference
    "-DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=${libressl_install_dir}|${protobuf_install_dir}"
    -DProtobuf_USE_STATIC_LIBS=ON
    -DLIGHT_TESTS=OFF
    -DGAMENETWORKINGSOCKETS_BUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF
    -DGAMENETWORKINGSOCKETS_BUILD_TESTS=OFF
    -DProtobuf_PROTOC_EXECUTABLE=${Protobuf_PROTOC_EXECUTABLE}
    "-DCMAKE_FIND_ROOT_PATH=${libressl_install_dir}|${protobuf_install_dir}"
    -DMSVC_RUNTIME:STRING=dynamic
    ${COMMON_FLAGS}
  USES_TERMINAL_CONFIGURE ON
  USES_TERMINAL_BUILD ON
  USES_TERMINAL_INSTALL ON
  BUILD_ALWAYS ${BUILD_ALWAYS_TOOLS}
)

  SDL3
  protobuf
  libressl
  GameNetworkingSockets
  spdlog
  physfs
  freetype
  dbg-macro

  boost.di
